claim: Unlike keys, HSM users and policies are not automatically resynchronized across the cluster; the CloudHSM CLI makes a best-effort synchronization and you may need to resolve inconsistencies manually.

evidence.quote: This automatic resynchronization applies only to keys. Users and policies (such as mTLS settings) are not automatically resynchronized.
The CloudHSM CLI performs best-effort synchronization of user and policy operations across HSMs, but inconsistencies can still occur and you may need to resolve them manually.
